newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil, Idemitsu cooperate in fuel oil supplies.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil, Idemitsu cooperate in fuel oil supplies.

text.p: Leading Japanese refiners Nippon Oil Co Ltd and Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd have started supplying fuel oil to each other to cut costs, spokesmen for the two firms said on Friday.
Nippon Oil, which runs a 385,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Yokohama, southwest of Tokyo, has begun distributing fuel oil to Idemitsu's customers in the Yokohama area.
Meanwhile, Idemitsu, with a 250,000 bpd plant in Chiba, east of Tokyo, has started supplying fuel oil to Nippon Oil's customers in Chiba.
Cooperation in fuel oil distribution would save Nippon Oil about one billion yen in the year to next March, a Nippon Oil spokesman said.
A similar deal has started between Idemitsu's 120,000 bpd Tokuyama plant and Nippon Oil affiliate Koa Oil Co Ltd's 127,000 bpd Marifu refinery, both in Yamaguchi Prefecture in western Japan.
Nippon Oil and Idemitsu earlier this year started operating coastal tankers jointly and supplying jet fuel to each other in some regions in an effort to cut distribution costs.
A fall in retail gasoline prices resulting from the deregulation of oil product imports in April has substantially shrunk Japanese oil firms' revenues.
